title: Traditional Irish Session @ Hibernia Irish Tavern
event_description: Weekly traditional Irish music jam session where musicians gather to play Celtic tunes. Open to all skill levels and instruments welcome. A welcoming atmosphere for both players and listeners.
venue_address: 9700 N Rodney Parham Rd Suite K Little Rock AR 72227
event_venue_information:
About Hibernia Irish Tavern

Hibernia Irish Tavern is an authentic wholly Irish-owned pub that brings the true spirit of Ireland to Little Rock. The venue features a stage that regularly hosts both contemporary local bands and traditional Irish music performances.

Music Events

The tavern proudly hosts the Little Rock Folk Club every month and features traditional Irish sessions on Sunday afternoons. Live entertainment takes the stage many nights per week featuring local and regional talent. At least once per month the venue hosts an award-winning musician or band from Ireland including internationally acclaimed harpists button-box players guitarists and singers.

Atmosphere and Amenities

The pub offers a well-stocked bar with an excellent selection of Irish beers on tap including what many consider the best Guinness in Little Rock. The menu features authentic Irish cuisine from freshly made soups to unique sandwich combinations to heartier stews and entrees. The staff is known for being friendly and welcoming creating a lively atmosphere perfect for both music and conversation.

title: Jazz Night Jam Session @ Trio's Restaurant
event_description: Bi-weekly jazz jam session featuring some of the best musicians in the Little Rock area. A true jam session where musicians come together to create spontaneous music. One of the best music audiences in town.
venue_address: 8201 Cantrell Rd Suite 100 Little Rock AR 72227
event_venue_information:
About Trio's Restaurant

Trio's Restaurant is widely regarded as Little Rock's best restaurant combining exceptional cuisine with world-class jazz nights. The establishment serves lunch Monday through Saturday and dinner Tuesday through Saturday with daily lunch specials and regularly updated dinner specials.

Jazz Night Events

The Jazz Night Jam Sessions at Trio's have become legendary in the Little Rock music scene. These bi-weekly Thursday night events bring together the finest jazz musicians in Central Arkansas for true improvised jam sessions. The pavilion room transforms into an intimate jazz club where the quality of musicianship matches the quality of the food.

Dining and Atmosphere

The restaurant is Green Restaurant Certified and focuses on seasonal creative menus using local produce. Popular dishes include beef tenderloin Thai shrimp curry blackberry pork chop with goat cheese butter and the famous spicy spinach dip. The cozy atmosphere and attentive staff make every meal feel like an event. The venue offers patio dining and an onsite bar and is family-friendly while maintaining an upscale ambiance.

Event Details

Doors open at 6:30 PM with music beginning at 7:00 PM. Tickets are sold by tables of 2 4 6 and 8 as well as individual bar seats. Food and beverages are available from Trio's full dinner menu and bar but are not included in ticket price.

title: Open Mic Comedy @ Hibernia Irish Tavern
event_description: Weekly comedy open mic night featuring standup comedians. A supportive atmosphere for both first-timers and experienced performers. Sign up starts early to secure your spot.
venue_address: 9700 N Rodney Parham Rd Suite K Little Rock AR 72227
event_venue_information:
About Hibernia Irish Tavern

Hibernia Irish Tavern is an authentic wholly Irish-owned pub that brings the true spirit of Ireland to Little Rock. Beyond its traditional Irish music sessions the venue has become a hub for various performance arts including comedy.

Open Mic Comedy Night

Every Tuesday night at 8:00 PM Hibernia transforms into a comedy club for The Mic at Hibernia. This weekly open mic provides a platform for standup comedians to test new material and hone their craft. The supportive crowd and welcoming atmosphere make it an ideal environment for both newcomers and seasoned comedians. Sign-up begins at 7:45 PM and spots fill up quickly.

Venue Atmosphere

The pub features a fun lively atmosphere with friendly chatty staff and a great selection of beers including the best Guinness in town. The menu offers authentic Irish cuisine with the fish and chips earning particular praise. The venue balances its Irish pub character with modern entertainment making it a versatile space for different types of performances.
